offering_description.value: Operates omnichannel marketplaces that sell used heavy equipment, trucks, and insurance and salvage vehicles through live and online auctions. Sells to commercial buyers and sellers, including contractors, dealers, insurers and fleet owners, and provides related services such as financing, inspections and logistics.

primary_services.value: auction marketplace services; vehicle remarketing; equipment listing and sales; financing; inspection, appraisal and logistics

customer_segment.value: B2B: Equipment owners, contractors, dealers, fleet operators, insurers, rebuilders and vehicle recyclers; B2G: Government agencies selling surplus equipment and vehicles; B2C: Individuals buying and selling vehicles and equipment

end_markets.value: construction; heavy equipment; transportation and trucking; agriculture; insurance and automotive salvage

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: commissions on auction sales of consigned equipment and vehicles; transaction or usage fees: buyer and seller fees on marketplace transactions; product sales: sales of inventory purchased outright by the company; service fees: financing, inspection, appraisal, listing and logistics services
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: online auction marketplaces connecting sellers with global buyers; asset operator: physical auction sites and yards for equipment and vehicles; financial intermediary: financing services for equipment buyers
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; asset operator; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia, Australia and the Middle East, with buyers in 170+ countries

specialization.value: related lines: Heavy equipment auctions, insurance vehicle auctions, online marketplaces and financing services

distribution_channels.value: online: online auction and marketplace platforms; own locations: physical auction sites and yards; direct sales: sales teams working with consignors and large accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Auctioneer licensing, vehicle title and salvage rules, consumer finance rules, and cross-border trade and environmental rules

notes: Some details uncertain; it does buy some inventory outright, but it is mainly a marketplace.
